name: Calm-VIX ADX breakout — 4h crypto trend entries permitted only in a low-vol macro regime
rationale: MECHANISM: same 'calm macro lets trends run' thesis, but the crypto side is a faster ADX-confirmed breakout on a 4h bar (an established directional trend, not a raw return) and the calm gate is VIX-only — testing whether equity-vol calm alone conditions crypto trend persistence without the credit leg. In a low-VIX regime there is no cross-asset VaR shock to unwind trends, so an ADX-confirmed breakout is more likely to follow through. Distinct from hh-macro-17 by bar (4h vs daily), crypto gauge (adx breakout vs ret_Nd), and macro gate (VIX-only vs VIX+credit). DISCONFIRMER: VIX is a daily read that a 4h bar cannot refresh intraday — the calm gate persists stale across the day, so the 4h frequency may only add fees over the daily version. Kill unless the ADX-breakout-in-calm spec beats an identical ADX breakout with NO VIX gate on OOS net-of-fee Sharpe; the calm filter must add lift, not just trim. Curve-fit risk is high (calm and trending overlap).
catalyst: low-VIX regime with a confirmed crypto ADX breakout
